scope: Proposition 2.11 of the manuscript “Hilbert’s tenth problem over the rational numbers” (preprints/Hilberts-tenth-problem-over-the-rational-numbers-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 004 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f79236c22b981fe6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an ordinary K ≥ 1 and use the exceptional set SK above. Choose a representation supplied at precision K for an arbitrary A ∈ R, and put e si = (e ui : e v). For every prime q of ∗Z counted by any MK(e si), and every a ∈ R, the element e a is integral at q and vq(e a − η(a)) ≥ K. (2.20)
